keyed.HH.Dlc.Gizmo.BuyDesc: Buy absolution, mercy or rank for a colonist. Prices follow their ideoligion's stance. The silver comes from colony stock or their pocket.
keyed.HH.Dlc.Gizmo.ChooseFaithDesc: Dedicate this altar to an ideoligion. Its followers among your guests will come here to pray.
keyed.HH.Dlc.Gizmo.FundDesc: Where your colonists' payments go. The deity keeps them for good; a faction of the same faith warms to you (+1 goodwill per 500 silver, at most +5 per quadrum).
keyed.HH.Dlc.Noble.Arrived: A {0} and retinue arrive for {1} days.
keyed.HH.Dlc.Noble.BilletText: The Empire orders you to lodge a {0} and {1} retainers for {2} days. They expect a bedroom worthy of their rank ({3}). You will receive about {4} silver for expenses. Refusing costs goodwill and honor.
keyed.HH.Dlc.Noble.Left: The noble party leaves. Payment: {0} silver.
keyed.HH.Dlc.Noble.OfferText: A {0} with {1} retainers asks to stay for {2} days and will pay about {3} silver if they are comfortable. They expect: {4}. Declining costs nothing.
keyed.HH.Dlc.NothingOffered: their faith offers nothing for sale
keyed.HH.Dlc.Reason.CapColony: the colony has bought this already this quadrum
keyed.HH.Dlc.Reason.CapIdeo: the ideoligion has had enough of this for this quadrum
keyed.HH.Dlc.Reason.NoFresh: no fresh wound of up to 10 hit points
keyed.HH.Dlc.Reason.NoGuilt: no memory of a broken commandment
keyed.HH.Dlc.Reason.NotAThing: their faith has no such thing
keyed.HH.Dlc.Reason.PsylinkMax: psylink is already at its limit
keyed.HH.Dlc.Reason.RankHeld: already holds this rank or a higher one
keyed.HH.Setting.dlc.traitSpawn: New traits appear on generated people
keyed.HH.Setting.dlc.traitSpawn.Desc: Lucky, Unlucky, Born host and the other Hearth & Harbor traits can show up on newly generated pawns. Existing pawns keep theirs. Off: only added by hand or editor.
keyed.HH.Setting.dlc.traitRarity.Desc: Multiplier on how often our traits are rolled for new pawns (1 = same rarity as most vanilla traits).

defs.GeneDef/HH_Gene_Hospitable.label: hospitable
defs.GeneDef/HH_Gene_Hospitable.description: Carriers are warm without trying. Guests find them easy to be around, and hosting comes quicker to them.
defs.GeneDef/HH_Gene_AddictionProofReward.des: The reward circuit of the brain barely reacts to risk and chance. Gambling rarely becomes a habit.
defs.GeneDef/HH_Gene_Compulsive.label: compulsive
defs.GeneDef/HH_Gene_Compulsive.description: An overactive reward circuit. Gambling is a little more fun, and a lot harder to put down.
defs.GeneDef/HH_Gene_DexterousFingers.label: dexterous fingers
defs.GeneDef/HH_Gene_DexterousFingers.descrip: Unusually fine hand control: shuffling, dealing and palming come naturally.
defs.GeneDef/HH_Gene_RefinedPalate.label: refined palate
defs.GeneDef/HH_Gene_RefinedPalate.descriptio: A tongue that tells good cooking from merely edible. Cooks lift dish quality more often; as a guest the carrier expects more and tips more.
defs.GeneDef/HH_Gene_NumberSense.label: number sense
defs.GeneDef/HH_Gene_NumberSense.description: Numbers arrange themselves. Croupiers, cashiers and bank clerks with this gene work as if three skill levels better.
defs.GeneDef/HH_Gene_TirelessSmile.label: tireless smile
defs.GeneDef/HH_Gene_TirelessSmile.descriptio: The smile muscles do not tire. Serving at tables and counters drains rest far more slowly.
defs.GeneDef/HH_Gene_SilverTongue.label: silver tongue
defs.GeneDef/HH_Gene_SilverTongue.description: A voice that makes any price sound like a bargain. Guests expect slightly less and loyalty comes cheaper.
defs.GeneDef/HH_Gene_HighRoller.label: high roller
defs.GeneDef/HH_Gene_HighRoller.description: Carriers feel most alive when the stakes are high. They bet bigger, enjoy it more and tip generously, but they are also harder to pull away from the table.
defs.IssueDef/HH_Indulgences.label: indulgences
defs.IssueDef/HH_PaidAscension.label: paid ascension
defs.HistoryEventDef/HH_BoughtAscension.label: bought an ascension
defs.PreceptDef/HH_Indulgences_NotAThing.desc: Nobody here has ever thought of selling forgiveness. Nothing to buy, nothing to object to.
defs.PreceptDef/HH_Indulgences_Abhorrent.desc: Forgiveness is not a commodity. Anyone who sells it should be driven from the temple.
defs.PreceptDef/HH_Indulgences_Disapproved.de: Buying absolution is a shabby habit. It works, but nobody should be proud of it.
defs.PreceptDef/HH_Indulgences_Accepted.label: accepted
defs.PreceptDef/HH_Indulgences_Accepted.descr: A fair offering for a fair mercy. The price is on the sign.
defs.PreceptDef/HH_Indulgences_Sacred.label: sacred
defs.PreceptDef/HH_Indulgences_Sacred.descrip: Paying one's dues is a sacrament. The faithful get a discount, and a cheap conscience is a duty.
defs.PreceptDef/HH_PaidAscension_NotAThing.de: Rank is earned here, never bought. Nothing to buy, nothing to object to.
defs.PreceptDef/HH_PaidAscension_Abhorrent.de: Faith is not for sale. Anyone who sells rank has already lost it.
A bought rank is a hollow rank. The congregation sees through it.
defs.PreceptDef/HH_PaidAscension_Accepted.des: Rank can be bought, at the posted price, like everything else of value.
defs.PreceptDef/HH_PaidAscension_Sacred.label: sacred
defs.PreceptDef/HH_PaidAscension_Sacred.descr: The ladder is the faith. Every rung bought is a rung climbed, and the ones below look up with respect.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_FaithForSale.stages.0.desc: They sell forgiveness out in the open, like turnips.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_FaithNotForSale.stages.0.d: Faith is not for sale. And yet there is a price list.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_BoughtMyWayOut.stages.0.de: It worked, but I paid for it, and I know exactly what that makes me.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_PaidMyDues.stages.0.label: paid my dues
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_PaidMyDues.stages.0.descri: My dues are paid. The books are clean and so is my conscience.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_StingySoul.stages.0.label: stingy soul
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_StingySoul.stages.0.descri: A whole quadrum without paying my dues. I should be ashamed.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_AscensionMood.stages.0.des: I have taken the first step of the ladder.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_AscensionMood.stages.1.des: The second rung. People start to use my title.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_AscensionMood.stages.2.des: The third rung. The view is already better.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_AscensionMood.stages.3.des: The last rung. Nobody above me but the sky.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_AscensionDisapproval.stage: They bought that rank. It means nothing.
They have climbed higher than I have. I respect that.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_PlaceToPray.stages.0.label: a place to pray
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_PlaceToPray.stages.0.descr: A modest corner for prayer. Better than nothing.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_PlaceToPray.stages.1.label: a place to pray
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_PlaceToPray.stages.1.descr: A quiet, decent chapel. I could pray here.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_PlaceToPray.stages.2.label: a place to pray
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_PlaceToPray.stages.2.descr: A fine chapel of my own faith, far from home. I am grateful.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_PlaceToPray.stages.3.label: a place to pray
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_PlaceToPray.stages.3.descr: A beautiful chapel with proper seats. My faith has been seen.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_PlaceToPray.stages.4.label: a place to pray
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_PlaceToPray.stages.4.descr: Splendid. They built a house for my god here. I will remember this.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_HereticShrine.stages.0.des: There is a shrine to a false faith on our land.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_HereticShrine.stages.1.des: A shrine to a false faith, tolerated by my own people. Shameful.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_HereticShrine.stages.2.des: They built a shrine for heretics next to our home. I cannot bear it.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_ShrineRespected.stages.0.d: We make room for other faiths. That is how it should be.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_ShrineRespected.stages.1.d: A shrine for every faith that passes through. That is how it should be.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_ShrineRespected.stages.2.d: Why do we build shrines for people who believe the wrong things?
defs.Hearth.IndulgenceDef/HH_Ind_ExpressAbsol: A stamped slip that wipes one memory of a broken commandment. The priest does not ask what you did.
defs.Hearth.IndulgenceDef/HH_Ind_MinorMercy.d: A blessed bandage, sold at the price of two doses of medicine. Heals one fresh wound of up to 10 hit points.
defs.Hearth.IndulgenceDef/HH_Ind_UnshakenFait: A framed certificate that says you never doubted. Raises certainty by ten percentage points.
defs.Hearth.IndulgenceDef/HH_Ind_GreaterMercy: A priced miracle. Heals one lasting scar or old wound for good.
defs.Hearth.IndulgenceDef/HH_Asc_Rank1.label: ascension: seeker
defs.Hearth.IndulgenceDef/HH_Asc_Rank1.descri: Pay the entry fee and become a Seeker. A start, nothing more.
defs.Hearth.IndulgenceDef/HH_Asc_Rank2.label: ascension: adept
defs.Hearth.IndulgenceDef/HH_Asc_Rank2.descri: Rank II, Adept. From here on the holder may sell indulgences at the altar to guests and visitors of other houses.
defs.Hearth.IndulgenceDef/HH_Asc_Rank3.label: ascension: luminary
defs.Hearth.IndulgenceDef/HH_Asc_Rank3.descri: Rank III, Luminary. Light enough to be noticed from far away.
defs.Hearth.IndulgenceDef/HH_Asc_Rank4.label: ascension: ascendant
defs.Hearth.IndulgenceDef/HH_Asc_Rank4.descri: Rank IV, Ascendant. The top of the ladder, for those who can afford the view.
A voluntary tithe towards the next reform of a fluid ideoligion: one reform point.
defs.IncidentDef/HH_NobleStay.label: noble stay
defs.IncidentDef/HH_NobleStay.letterText: A noble party asks for lodging.
defs.IncidentDef/HH_ImperialBilleting.label: imperial billeting
defs.ThingDef/HH_GuestAltar.label: guest altar
defs.ThingDef/HH_GuestAltar.description: A small altar for the faith of travellers. Pick an ideoligion you know: guests who follow it find a place to pray, donate to the temple fund, and may buy indulgences here. Your own colonists of other faiths may object.
defs.StatDef/HH_ServiceQuality.label: service quality
defs.StatDef/HH_ServiceQuality.description: How pleasant this person is to be served by. Added to the satisfaction of guests they talk to, and read by shops, kitchens and the front desk.
defs.StatDef/HH_HostingLearn.label: hosting learning
defs.StatDef/HH_HostingLearn.description: Multiplier on the social experience gained while hosting guests.
defs.StatDef/HH_GuestExpectation.label: guest expectation
defs.StatDef/HH_GuestExpectation.description: Added to what a guest expects from a stay. Positive means harder to please. Charm and good manners lower it; a refined palate raises it.
defs.StatDef/HH_GamblingJoy.label: gambling joy
defs.StatDef/HH_GamblingJoy.description: Multiplier on the joy this person draws from gambling.
defs.StatDef/HH_GamblingAddiction.label: gambling addiction chance
defs.StatDef/HH_GamblingAddiction.description: Multiplier on the chance that gambling becomes an addiction. Zero means this person never gets hooked.
defs.StatDef/HH_Dexterity.label: sleight of hand
defs.StatDef/HH_Dexterity.description: Skill levels added to fine hand work at tables: dealing, shuffling, and house cheating.
defs.StatDef/HH_TableSkill.label: counting skill
defs.StatDef/HH_TableSkill.description: Skill levels added when working as croupier, cashier or bank clerk.
defs.StatDef/HH_FraudDetection.label: fraud detection
defs.StatDef/HH_FraudDetection.description: Multiplier on noticing forged chips, cheating guests and short-changing.
defs.StatDef/HH_TheftChance.label: theft in their room
defs.StatDef/HH_TheftChance.description: Multiplier on the chance that something is stolen in a room this person looks after.
defs.StatDef/HH_BrawlRisk.label: brawl risk around them
defs.StatDef/HH_BrawlRisk.description: Multiplier on the chance of a quarrel turning into a fight in this person's room.
defs.StatDef/HH_RumorSpread.label: rumour spread
defs.StatDef/HH_RumorSpread.description: Multiplier on how far stories about the house travel, good or bad.
defs.StatDef/HH_CareProgress.label: care progress
defs.StatDef/HH_CareProgress.description: Multiplier on patient and rehab progress while this person looks after them.
defs.StatDef/HH_BankFeeFactor.label: bank fees
defs.StatDef/HH_BankFeeFactor.description: Multiplier on the fees the bank charges this person.
defs.StatDef/HH_Negotiation.label: negotiation bonus
defs.StatDef/HH_Negotiation.description: Added to insurance and contract negotiations.
defs.StatDef/HH_RecruitPrice.label: recruitment surcharge
defs.StatDef/HH_RecruitPrice.description: Multiplier on the surcharge above the price floor when buying a guest's loyalty.
defs.StatDef/HH_ServeRestFactor.label: tiredness while serving
defs.StatDef/HH_ServeRestFactor.description: Multiplier on how fast rest drains while waiting tables or serving at a counter.
defs.StatDef/HH_TipFactor.label: tips
defs.StatDef/HH_TipFactor.description: Multiplier on the tips this person leaves as a guest.
defs.StatDef/HH_DishQuality.label: dish quality chance
defs.StatDef/HH_DishQuality.description: Chance to lift the quality of a cooked dish by one step.
defs.StatDef/HH_FamilyCheer.label: family cheer
defs.StatDef/HH_FamilyCheer.description: Added to the satisfaction of families and children in this person's care.
defs.StatDef/HH_PriceFeel.label: price feel
defs.StatDef/HH_PriceFeel.description: Added to how expensive guests find this person's prices.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_LuckyStreak.stages.0.label: lucky streak
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_LuckyStreak.stages.0.descr: The dice keep falling my way tonight.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_OfCourseILost.stages.0.des: Of course I lost. Of course.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_GamblingAround.stages.0.de: People are throwing money away right in front of me.
defs.Hearth.XenotypeHospitalityDef/HH_XenoHos: baseliner
Plain folk: sober tastes, careful with money. Large, thrifty groups.
sanguophage
Sanguophages want dark rooms and a hemogen minibar within reach. A deathrest lounge is something they will pay for.
hemogenic (any xenotype)
Anyone with the hemogenic gene, including custom xenotypes, shares the Sanguophage taste for dark rooms and hemogen packs.
UV-sensitive (any xenotype)
Sunlight hurts. A dark, indoor room is a comfortable room.
dirtmole
Dirtmoles prefer dark, windowless rooms and mushroom dishes. They offer to pay for a guided tour of the mine.
genie
Geniuses expect a reading nook and a quiet table. They rent research rooms.
hussar
Hussars spend freely at the bar and enjoy a good brawl, with the quarrels that come with it.
neanderthal
Big portions, simple rooms. Furnishing counts for less.
pigskin
Pigskins eat almost anything and do not mind a messy room.
impid
Impids like warm rooms and spice. They perform for a share of the takings.
waster
Wasters feel at home in dirty rooms, spend a lot and leave a mess.
yttakin
Yttakin want cold rooms; warm ones make them miserable.
highmate
Highmates love beauty and company. Handsome shared rooms please them.
